description:
*Objective:* Verify that raising a cart line's quantity above available stock is rejected and the stored quantity stays unchanged.

*Type:* negative  
*Level:* end-to-end  
*Priority:* high

*Preconditions:*
* Application is reachable (local disposable environment)
* A regular user account is available
* Books are located by title via catalog search, never by ID, because IDs change when the database is reseeded
* Book "Ariel" is in stock; read its real stock S0

*Test data:*
* Book: Ariel
* Initial quantity: 1
* Attempted cart quantity: S0 + 1

*Steps & Expected results:*
# Open the login page and sign in with the regular user account  
   *Expected:* User lands on the catalog page; the Logout button is visible
# Open the cart; remove every line that is present  
   *Expected:* Cart is empty; the cart badge in the navigation is absent or 0
# On the catalog page type "Ariel" into the search box and click Search  
   *Expected:* A catalog card titled "Ariel" is listed
# Open the detail page of "Ariel"  
   *Expected:* Detail page opens with heading "Ariel"
# Read the stock number next to Stock and remember it as S0  
   *Expected:* A stock number is shown
# With Quantity 1 click Add to Cart  
   *Expected:* Cart badge shows 1
# Open the cart  
   *Expected:* One line "Ariel" with quantity 1
# Change the line's quantity to S0 + 1 and commit it (Enter or blur)  
   *Expected:* A visible error states there is not enough stock
# Reload the cart page  
   *Expected:* Line "Ariel" still shows quantity 1; cart badge shows 1

*Postconditions:*
* Cart line quantity is unchanged

*Traceability:*
* User story: REF-10
* Related bug: REF-29
title: Reject raising cart quantity above stock
